# EVE-Dash
> Eliminate alt-tab fatigue with this zero-backend EVE Online dashboard.

## Overview
EVE-Dash is an open-source, purely client-side SPA (Single Page Application) built with Next.js (App Router, static export), React, Tailwind CSS, and Zustand. It serves as a unified command center for multiboxers in the game EVE Online.

## Architecture & Security (Zero-Backend)
EVE-Dash uses a strict Zero-Trust, Zero-Backend architecture. 
- It uses the EVE SSO PKCE OAuth flow, meaning no `client_secret` is ever required.
- Access and Refresh tokens are stored strictly within the browser's IndexedDB (`idb-keyval`) using Web Crypto API encryption.
- No central database or API exists. All data fetches to the EVE Swagger Interface (ESI) occur directly from the user's browser via Web Workers to prevent UI thread blocking.

## Tech Stack
- Framework: Next.js (Static Export)
- Styling: Tailwind CSS (Strictly forbidding generic shadow/rounded classes in favor of an EVE NeoCom aesthetic)
- State Management: Zustand
- Data Validation: Zod (Strict schema validation for all ESI payloads)

## Data Polling
Polling logic (`esiWorker.ts`) handles HTTP 429 exponential backoffs and gracefully pauses during EVE Online's daily downtime (11:00-11:15 UTC).
